job.title: Staff Full Stack Engineer, GTM Systems
job.description: The role involves designing and building AI-native systems for revenue teams at Upside, including developing applications, partnering with teams, managing the entire stack, and improving system reliability and performance.
responsibilities: Build applications and tools that accelerate Upside's go-to-market motion
Partner closely with cross-functional teams to understand business workflows
Own systems end to end, designing across the stack from front-end interfaces to backend services
Improve the systems you build by finding opportunities to increase reliability, performance, and scalability
Apply prompt design and prompt engineering as a core part of building AI-powered systems
Drive quality through clear communication and documentation
